semiconductor_relevance: High — Dean Tech Co., Ltd specializes in semiconductor analysis equipment and solutions, particularly in contamination analysis and process improvement.
summary: Dean Tech Co., Ltd is the authorized distributor of Bruker in Taiwan, focusing on the sales and application of EDXRF series spectrometers for semiconductor materials analysis. The company provides comprehensive solutions for surface residual contamination analysis and process optimization in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Process improvement solutions from WET Clean to back-end packaging

regional_presence.Taiwan: Dean Tech Co., Ltd operates as the official distributor for Bruker in Taiwan, providing localized support and services.
